DJ Services

Professional DJ services tailored for your event. From intimate weddings to high-energy club nights, corporate galas to custom music production.

Weddings & Private Events

Tailored Music From Ceremony to Last Dance

Your wedding day deserves a soundtrack as unique as your love story. We work with you to curate every moment — from the walk down the aisle to the final song of the night.

  • Custom Playlist Consultation — Two included sessions to nail every song choice
  • Professional MC Services — Announcements, introductions, timeline management
  • Ceremony → Cocktail → Reception Flow — Seamless transitions, zero dead air
  • Wireless Mic for Speeches — Crystal clear audio for toasts and vows
  • Setup & Breakdown Included — We handle the gear, you enjoy the party
  • Backup Equipment On-Site — Redundancy for peace of mind
  • South Florida Travel Included — No hidden fees within service area
Starting at $1,500 50% deposit to hold date · Balance due day-of

Booking Process

1

Inquire

Fill out the contact form with date, venue, event type, and vision.

2

Consult

15-min call to discuss logistics, budget, and musical direction.

3

Proposal

Detailed quote with rider, timeline, payment schedule, and contract.

4

Deposit

50% holds your date (Venmo, Zelle, Check, Wire). Date locked.

5

Plan

Playlist collaboration, timeline finalization, vendor coordination.

6

Perform

Show up early, deliver flawlessly, exceed expectations.

7

Balance

Remaining balance due day-of or per corporate terms.
